name: BankAmericard Secured Credit Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but earns nothing and requires a refundable $200–$5,000 deposit
balance_transfer_fee: 5% of the amount of each transaction
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

verdict.text: No rewards, no intro APR: other secured BofA cards earn for free

earn_note: This is the secured version of BankAmericard, and it earns no rewards. Secured cards aren't eligible for BankAmericard's 0% intro APR. It does have a lower APR than the other secured BofA cards (26.24% against 27.74%) and no penalty APR. If you'd pay in full each month, Cash Rewards Secured or Unlimited Cash Rewards Secured cost the same to open and earn rewards.

points.note: Nothing to redeem. Value is purely the credit-building mechanism, not any earning.

transfer_partners.highlight: No rewards program, nothing to transfer.
